varieties.name: Apple
varieties.supplier_notes: Most-planted Kenyan mango; sweet, fibreless; local market dominant.

varieties.name: Tommy Atkins
varieties.supplier_notes: Main export variety; ships well; firmer flesh.

varieties.name: Kent
varieties.supplier_notes: Premium export; sweeter than Tommy; late season.

timeline_template.description_en: Mark planting holes 8m x 8m for grafted trees. Dig 60cm cubed; mix soil + 2 tins manure.
Plant grafted seedling at nursery depth. Stake to prevent wind damage.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mche kina sawa na kitalu. Simika nguzo.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100g DAP per hole, well-mixed below the rootball.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 100 za DAP kwa shimo.

timeline_template.description_en: Water 20L per tree every 10 days for first 6 months if no rain.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwagilia lita 20 kila siku 10 kwa miezi 6.

timeline_template.description_en: Mulch the basin 50cm radius around trunk. Don't pile against bark.
timeline_template.description_sw: Funika kuzunguka mti urefu cm 50. Usigusane na gome.
Weka gramu 250 za NPK kwa mti.

timeline_template.description_en: Train to 3-4 main scaffold branches. Remove low branches < 60cm from ground.
timeline_template.description_sw: Fanya matawi 3-4 ya msingi. Ondoa matawi chini ya cm 60.

timeline_template.description_en: Year 2 NPK: 500g per tree, split 2 doses.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwaka 2: gramu 500 za NPK kwa mti, dosi 2.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for mango fruit fly + thrips at flowering of year 2-3.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya mango fruit fly + thrips wakati wa maua.

timeline_template.description_en: Protect the panicles at bloom — anthracnose and powdery mildew at flowering decide the whole season's crop.
timeline_template.description_sw: Linda maua — anthracnose na ukungu wakati wa maua huamua mavuno ya msimu mzima.

timeline_template.description_en: First commercial fruit at year 2-3 (grafted). Pick at mature-green stage for export.
timeline_template.description_sw: Matunda ya kwanza mwaka 2-3 (kupandikiza). Vuna yakiwa magumu kabla ya kuiva.
timeline_template.tip_en: Apple: pick when shoulder fills + skin lightens. Tommy: hard fruit, 12% Brix.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Apple: vuna mabega yakijaa. Tommy: tunda gumu.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Export A: 300-500g, no blemishes, 1 stem cm. Local B: 200-300g or minor flaws.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: 13°C optimal. Refrigeration below 10°C causes chilling injury.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: 13°C ndiyo bora. Friji chini ya 10°C huharibu.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pin-prick stings on ripening fruit, larvae inside, premature drop.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kuchomwa kwenye matunda yanayoiva, viluwiluwi ndani, kuanguka mapema.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered bait sprays; orchard sanitation. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za chambo zilizoidhinishwa; usafi wa shamba. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (leaf spots) · High (flower blight, fruit rot)
diseases.symptoms_en: Dark spots on leaves and panicles, black sunken rot on ripening fruit, wet weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi majani na maua, uoza mweusi kwenye matunda yanayoiva, mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered anthracnose-active sprays at flowering and fruit set. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa wakati wa maua na matunda kukaa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Prune for airflow, remove debris, dry handling.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kata matawi kwa hewa, ondoa mabaki, shika pakavu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Flower-panicle photo at bloom; fruit close-up at ripening.

diseases.symptoms_en: White powder on panicles and young fruit, flower drop, warm-dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Unga mweupe kwenye maua na matunda machanga, maua huanguka, joto na ukavu.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting during bloom. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza wakati wa maua. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silver-bronze fruit scarring, distorted young leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Matunda yenye makovu ya fedha, majani machanga yaliyopinda.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered products at threshold. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: White cottony colonies on stems and fruit, sticky honeydew, black sooty mould follows.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi meupe kama pamba kwenye mashina na matunda, utomvu unanata, ukungu mweusi hufuata.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered products at threshold; oil sprays. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa wakati wamezidi; dawa za mafuta. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kata matawi mazito, maadui wa asili.

diseases.symptoms_en: Black film on leaves and fruit growing on insect honeydew.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Ukungu mweusi majani na matunda unaokua kwenye utomvu wa wadudu.
diseases.treatment_en: Control the sap-sucking insects — the mould follows them. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dhibiti wadudu wanaonyonya — ukungu huwafuata. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Dhibiti magamba na wadudu wa pamba.
diseases.scanner_notes: Black film + insects present = honeydew source.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Seasonal crop — main harvest Dec–Mar depending on variety and zone. The 13°C cold-chain rule keeps export grade from field to port.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Zao la msimu — mavuno makuu Des–Mar kutegemea aina na eneo. Kanuni ya baridi ya 13°C hudumisha daraja la kuuza nje.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Local ~20–60 KES per fruit by size; export grades several multiples (November 2026). Apple, Tommy Atkins and Kent cover early-to-late windows.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Soko la ndani ~20–60 KES kwa tunda; la nje mara kadhaa zaidi (Novemba 2026). Apple, Tommy Atkins na Kent hufunika misimu yote.
